places.name: Well
places.rules: Choose one hero and take a Toughness test for him. If he passes he finds a shard of wyrdstone; if he fails he misses the next game.

places.name: Shop
places.rules: D6 gc. If a 1 is rolled he also finds a Lucky Charm.

places.name: Corpse
places.rules: Roll a D6: 1-2 D6 gc; 3 a Dagger; 4 an Axe; 5 a Sword; 6 a suit of Light Armour.

places.name: Straggler
places.rules: Skaven: 2D6 gc. The Possessed: the leader gains +1 Experience. Undead: the warband gains a Zombie. Any other warband: roll one additional exploration die and drop the lowest.

places.name: Overturned Cart
places.rules: Roll a D6: 1-2 a Mordheim Map; 3-4 2D6 gc; 5-6 a Jewelled Sword and Dagger.

places.name: Ruined Hovels
places.rules: D6 gc.

places.name: Tavern
places.rules: The leader must take a Leadership test. If he passes the warband receives 4D6 gc; if he fails, D6 gc. Undead, Witch Hunter and Sisters of Sigmar warbands need no Leadership test.

places.name: Smithy
places.rules: Roll a D6: 1 a Sword; 2 a Double-handed weapon; 3 a Flail; 4 D3 Halberds; 5 a Lance; 6 2D6 gc worth of metal.

places.name: Prisoners
places.rules: The Possessed: D3 Experience for the heroes. Undead: D3 Zombies. Skaven: 3D6 gc. Any other warband: 2D6 gc and one Human henchman.

places.name: Fletcher
places.rules: Roll a D6: 1-2 D3 Short bows; 3 D3 Bows; 4 D3 Long bows; 5 a Quiver of Hunting Arrows; 6 D3 Crossbows.

places.name: Market Hall
places.rules: 2D6 gc.

places.name: Returning a Favour
places.rules: A Hired Sword for one battle.

places.name: Gunsmith
places.rules: Roll a D6: 1 a Blunderbuss; 2 a Brace of Pistols; 3 a Brace of Duelling Pistols; 4 D3 Handguns; 5 D3 doses of Superior Black Powder; 6 a Hochland Long Rifle.

places.name: Shrine
places.rules: 3D6 gc. Witch Hunters and Sisters of Sigmar may have one weapon blessed.

places.name: Townhouse
places.rules: 3D6 gc.

places.name: Armourer
places.rules: Roll a D6: 1-2 D3 Shields or Bucklers; 3 D3 Helmets; 4 D3 suits of Light Armour; 5 D3 suits of Heavy Armour; 6 a suit of Ithilmar Armour.

places.name: Graveyard
places.rules: D6x10 gc. Witch Hunter and Sisters of Sigmar warbands gain D6 Experience to share among their heroes.

places.name: Catacombs
places.rules: Next game three fighters may be placed anywhere on the battlefield at ground level.

places.name: Moneylender's House
places.rules: D6x10 gc.

places.name: Alchemist's Laboratory
places.rules: 3D6 gc and an Alchemist's Notebook: one warrior may now choose skills from the Academic skill list.

places.name: Jewelsmith
places.rules: Roll a D6: 1-2 a Quartz worth D6x5 gc; 3-4 an Amethyst worth 20 gc; 5 a Necklace worth 50 gc; 6 a Ruby worth D6x15 gc. The warband may decide not to sell the jewels and gain +1 when locating rare items instead.

places.name: Merchant's House
places.rules: 2D6x5 gc, or, if doubles are rolled, a Symbol of the Order of the Freetraders.

places.name: Shattered Building
places.rules: D3 shards of wyrdstone. If the leader passes a Leadership test the warband gains a War Dog.

places.name: Entrance to the Catacombs
places.rules: From now on the warband may re-roll one die whenever it rolls on the exploration chart.

places.name: The Pit
places.rules: If you wish, you can send one of your Heroes to search for any wyrdstone hidden here. Roll a D6. On a roll of 1 the Hero is devoured by the guardians of the Pit and never seen again. On a roll of 2 or more he returns with D6+1 shards of wyrdstone.

places.name: Hidden Treasure
places.rules: A treasure chest. Roll a D6 for each of these, keeping what reaches its number: 5D6x5 gc, automatic; D3 pieces of wyrdstone, 4+; a Holy Relic, 5+; a suit of Heavy Armour, 5+; D3 gems worth 10 gc each, 4+; an Elven Cloak, 5+; a Holy Tome, 5+; a Magical Artefact, 5+.

places.name: Dwarf Smithy
places.rules: Roll a D6: 1 D3 Double-handed axes; 2 D3 suits of Heavy Armour; 3 a Gromril Axe; 4 a Gromril Hammer; 5 a Double-handed Gromril Axe; 6 Gromril Armour.

places.name: Slaughtered Warband
places.rules: Roll a D6 for each of these, keeping what reaches its number: 3D6x5 gc, automatic; D6 Daggers, automatic; D3 suits of Light Armour, 4+; a suit of Heavy Armour, 5+; a Mordheim Map, 4+; D3 Halberds, 5+; D3 Swords, 3+; D3 Shields, 2+; D3 Bows, 4+; D3 Helmets, 2+.

places.name: Fighting Arena
places.rules: A Training Manual. It can be sold for 100 gc, or one warrior may now choose skills from the Combat skill list and has +1 to his maximum Weapon Skill.

places.name: Noble's Villa
places.rules: Roll a D6: 1-2 D6x10 gc; 3-4 D6 vials of Crimson Shade; 5-6 a Magical Artefact.
